description: GBP SONIA curve built the way the platform's seeded 'GBP SONIA OIS (BoE, daily public)' curve is: a 6M deposit plus annual SwapHelpers (fixed leg Annual / ModifiedFollowing / Actual365Fixed on the UK calendar) whose float index is the SONIA overnight index, so the Bank of England public par strip reproduces. Curve Actual365Fixed / LogLinear / Discount.
provenance: quantra-backend scripts/seed_demo_entities.py: SONIA index (UnitedKingdom, Actual365Fixed, fixing_days 0), GBP SONIA OIS curve (Actual365Fixed, LogLinear, Discount; DepositHelper fixing_days 0 / UnitedKingdom / ModifiedFollowing / Actual365Fixed; SwapHelper UnitedKingdom / Annual / ModifiedFollowing / Actual365Fixed)

field_provenance.index.business_day_convention: market standard (ISDA/CCP), not from an in-repo source
field_provenance.index.end_of_month: market standard (ISDA/CCP), not from an in-repo source
field_provenance.helpers.swap.spread: explicit zero: the engine reads an absent spread as 0.0 (term_structure_point_parser.cpp); stated so nothing is implicit
field_provenance.helpers.swap.fwd_start_days: explicit zero: the engine reads an absent fwd_start_days as 0 (term_structure_point_parser.cpp); stated so nothing is implicit
